hero.title: Transforming Agriculture with Aerial Intelligence
hero.description: Leading Africa's Land and Aerial Surveying Revolution. SmartGrid Surveying empowers modern agriculture with cutting-edge drone solutions designed to maximize yields, reduce costs, and make data-driven farming a reality.

whyUseDronesInAgriculture.headline: Why Use Drones in Agriculture?
whyUseDronesInAgriculture.description: Our drone technology brings real-time insights from above—helping farmers monitor crops, optimize inputs, and make informed decisions across their agricultural operations.

items.title: Save Time & Labor
items.description: Cover large areas in minutes compared to manual fieldwork.

items.title: Improve Resource Efficiency
items.description: Apply inputs only where needed, reducing cost and environmental impact.

items.title: Make Smarter Decisions
items.description: Use aerial data for real-time field assessments and historical trend analysis.

items.title: Enhance Sustainability
items.description: Promote conservation agriculture through better land and input management.
